rules: Apply preparation to a copied initial exercise through the existing user-action reducer.
Use the exact same external incident schedule for baseline and retest.
No command time, duration or hazard fields; no resource grants or director actions as preparation.
Reject unknown versions, invalid preparation or invalid recorded references.
Preserve the source, proposed preparation, intervention, schedule and receipts for replay.
Compare final requirements and unknowns explicitly; inspect event history for earlier failures.
Preserving a resource or delaying its depletion does not establish full plan resolution.
Read-only counterfactual outer receipt remains the unchanged current exercise.
Never promote hypothetical actions to real household facts, tasks, inventory or scores.
